decisions.statement: The pages of a turned page type are the ones the index names, each read from its own body.
A file that is no page is not answered here though its body loads as a value.
Every page the index names is answered where a property's unique kind turns.
No page is answered for a unique kind where no unique kind turns.
A page type whose slug the change leaves naming no page type strands its pages.
A stranded page is answered so the change withdraws what that page was filed by.
A property is turned for relations where that property's key or target differs.
A property a change adds or takes away is turned for relations.
Which page types declare a property is read from the declarations rather than from an edge.
A page type is answered for a property every page type above that page type declares.
The declarers are read from the world before the change and the world after it.
A page the change has is not answered here.
An id left under no name is read from the identity lines a change takes away.
The pages naming an id are read from beside that id's page rather than sought.
A page naming an id has its value read from that page's own body.
A page whose body reads as no value of the type its name says is passed over.

definition: the pages a change files again though the change has none of them
